description: Plan Approval Receipt bootstrap. Trusted configuration: the workflow reads it from the checkout of the `main` commit it executes from and refuses to continue unless it equals main's; consumers recover it from the tip of `main` on GitHub, never from a worktree, a PR or an input. NON-CIRCULAR: this file holds no hash of itself; its identity (git blob, sha256, commit, repository id, run id) is recorded in each receipt as `trustedConfig` and compared with main by the verifier. Any change here changes that identity and blocks earlier receipts until they are reissued. Control plane (governance/gates/**): changing it needs human review. FAIL-CLOSED PINS, each of which blocks everything while unset: `requester.botUserId` (null until the GitHub App `ai-native-plan-approval` exists and a human pins its bot user id), `environment.id` (null until the dedicated Environment `ai-native-plan-approval` exists and a human pins its id) and `workflow.trustedRevisions` (empty until a human registers the git blobs of the integrated workflow files; see governance/security/PLAN-APPROVAL-RECEIPT.md). The Environment `ai-native-human-review` belongs to merge-gate and is intentionally NOT used here.
